description: This file defines an enum class 'CalendarLocation' with two possible values (INTERNAL and EXTERNAL) representing calendar locations. It also includes a method to get the opposite location.

classes.name: CalendarLocation
classes.description: An enum representing calendar locations with values INTERNAL and EXTERNAL, and a method to get the opposite location.

methods.name: getOpposite
methods.description: Returns the opposite calendar location: if INTERNAL, returns EXTERNAL, and vice versa.
